Step: 7 weeks = 49 days.  
49 days + 5 days = 54 days total.  
1672 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not century exception because 1600 is leap, 1700 is not, so 1672 is leap).  
From 1672-11-26, add 54 days:  
Nov 26 → Nov 30 is 4 days (remain 50 days).  
Dec has 31 days → Dec 30 is 30 days later (remain 20 days).  
Remaining 20 days into 1673 → 1673-01-20.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1673-01-20
